blocks.html:
Stratos Full Boat Wrap

This is the second boat Vinyl Wrap Toronto has wrapped this year. This Stratos Boat is the pride and joy of a regular customer wishing for us to do a full boat wrap to update his boat. We had already wrapped his golf cart in a similar design, Click here to view more. Vinyl Wrap Toronto also wrapped his other golf cart last year. All the designs were done in-house by Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s design team. Once the designs were completed, they were sent to the customer for approval, pending his decision, we started printing.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto can design, print, and install in-house on almost any vehicle or piece of equipment. The customer wanted the boat not only to be refreshed with the vinyl wrap but also to stand out. This was achieved with the use of colour and placement of the design. The boat would mostly be seen either on a trailer going to a lake or speeding along the water. The customer wanted the Stratos name to pop on the full boat wrap.

The vinyl we used is the same as we use for cars. Vinyl Wrap Toronto mainly uses Avery Dennison Printable vinyl for recreational wraps. We then laminate the printed vinyl for added protection and help to ensure the vinyl lasts. The laminate also helps with the general wear and tear that a recreational vehicle like this will endure. This is an added benefit of wrapping your boat.
Speak to our installation team about your recreational or equipment wraps at 416-746-1381. Click here to view the other boat wraps. Vinyl Wrap Toronto also does small decals, logos, or racing stripes.

Visit our garage to see vinyl samples at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit #1, Etobicoke, M9W 1B4.
